gbifID.description: Unique global occurrence identifier assigned by GBIF for each record.

datasetKey.description: Dataset identifier linking records to the GBIF dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URLs linking to iNaturalist records for each Pterostylis alpina sighting.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification for each record, always Plantae.

phylum.description: Plant kingdom phylum for each occurrence, always Tracheophyta.

class.description: Plant taxonomic class Liliopsida for each occurrence record.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species, consistently Asparagales.

family.description: Family classification for all records is Orchidaceae.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus of the orchid, consistently Pterostylis across all records.

species.description: Species name of the recorded orchid, always Pterostylis alpina.

infraspecificEpithet.description: All entries are missing, providing no taxonomic rank below species.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank for all records, consistently SPECIES.

scientificName.description: Taxonomic designation of the orchid species, including author citation.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded orchid species.

countryCode.description: Country of occurrence, using ISO two‑letter code, consistently Australia.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: Australian state where each record was observed.

occurrenceStatus.description: Occurrence status is always recorded as present for each record.

individualCount.description: Number of individuals observed for each occurrence record.

publishingOrgKey.description: Unique identifier of the organization that published each occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude of occurrence point expressed in decimal degrees.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of occurrence coordinates measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision field is missing for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation data missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation measurement accuracy is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth data missing for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy of occurrence location, data unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record, ranging from 1989 to 2025.

day.description: Day of month when the observation was recorded.

month.description: Month of observation, ranging from January (1) to December (12).

year.description: Calendar year of the occurrence record.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier for the species, identical for all occurrence records.

speciesKey.description: Unique taxonomic identifier for each Pterostylis alpina occurrence record.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source type, consistently human observation.

institutionCode.description: Institution code identifying iNaturalist as the data source for all records.

collectionCode.description: Uniform collection code for all records, set to “Observations”.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: No data recorded for this field.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded each Pterostylis alpina occurrence.

dateIdentified.description: Identification timestamp of each occurrence record.

license.description: Creative Commons license specifying data usage permissions.

rightsHolder.description: Names of individuals or entities holding rights to the occurrence records.

recordedBy.description: Names of individuals or groups who recorded each Pterostylis alpina occurrence.

typeStatus.description: No data recorded for this field; all entries are missing.

establishmentMeans.description: Information on native or introduced status is missing for all entries.

lastInterpreted.description: Timestamp of data extraction for each occurrence record.

mediaType.description: Media type of occurrence record, such as single or multiple still images.

issue.description: Data quality flags indicating coordinate rounding, continent derivation, and missing taxon identifier.

pterostylis_alpina.description: Occurrence records of Pterostylis alpina in Australia (2009‑2026) with taxonomy, location, date, and observer details.

description: Records of Pterostylis alpina occurrences from 2009‑2026, supporting biodiversity monitoring.
